name: printer-factory-sim
description: A discrete-event simulation of a full retail supply chain for 3D printers. Three autonomous microservices — Provider, Manufacturer, and Retailer — interact across simulated days. A Turn Engine orchestrates each day cycle, injects customer demand, and invokes AI agents at each node. You (or an AI agent) act as planner at any tier — managing inventory, purchasing, scheduling production, and fulfilling demand before the wallet runs dry.
